variants.name: 作って一覧で見る・--mount で付ける

create: docker volume create db-data && docker volume ls
attach: docker stop db && docker rm db
add: docker exec -it db psql -U postgres -d reserve -c "INSERT INTO reservations (name) VALUES ('市民ホール');"
keep: docker rm -f db && docker run -d --name db -v db-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data city-db:1.0
docker exec db psql -U postgres -d reserve -c 'SELECT * FROM reservations'

variants.name: -v で付けると同時に作られる

add: docker exec db psql -U postgres reserve -c "INSERT INTO reservations (name) VALUES ('市民ホール')"
keep: docker exec db psql -U postgres -d reserve -c "SELECT count(*) FROM reservations"

wrong.why: 前の db を消さずに同じ名前で作る
